name: Anton
beschreibung: The Hotel Anton is located in St. Anton am Arlberg, right next to the valley station of the Nassereinbahn cable car. The village centre can be reached in just a few minutes on foot. It is categorized as a distinguished four-star superior hotel. Its striking architecture blends modern forms with tactile alpine materials. The dining options include an upscale restaurant and a sophisticated wine bar. Spanning 1,300 square metres, the extensive wellness area features multiple saunas, a steam bath, and a serene relaxation pool. Rooms and suites are elegantly appointed with local timber and natural stone. Guests enjoy direct ski-in/ski-out slope access in winter, while in summer the hotel serves as an ideal base for hiking and mountain bike adventures.
